    • moveFolder

      String moveFolder(FolderMetadata folder, long destinationFolderId) throws Exception

      Moves folder(s) to new location.

      How it works:

      Generates Folder ID path if the target is 0 and the source is at 0/1/4/2 then it will be 0/2 original source will be 0/1/4 if target is 0/5/9 then it will be 0/5/9/2 and contents will be 0/5/9/2/x
      Parameters:
      folder - source folder metadata
      destinationFolderId - destination folder id
      Returns:
      updated path
      Throws:
      Exception - throws FileSystemException and FileNotFoundException
